technologies.name: Arecibo Radio Telescope
technologies.description: 305-meter radio telescope built 1963. Iconic SETI instrument. +10% detection range.

technologies.name: Drake Equation Analysis
technologies.description: Frank Drake's 1961 formula for estimating alien civilizations. +5% knowledge gain.

technologies.name: Basic Signal Processing
technologies.description: 1970s-era digital filtering and pattern recognition. +3 research points/turn.

technologies.name: Project Ozma Methods
technologies.description: First modern SETI search (1960). Narrow-band scanning techniques. +5% detection.

technologies.name: Voyager Golden Record
technologies.description: Message to the cosmos (sent 1977). Cultural package design. +10% message quality.

technologies.name: Public Education Initiative
technologies.description: Educate humanity about SETI importance. -0.2% support decay per generation.

technologies.name: SETI@Home Distributed Computing
technologies.description: Launched 1999. Harness millions of home PCs. +15 research points/turn.

technologies.name: Deep Space Network Upgrade
technologies.description: NASA's global communication array. +15% detection range.

technologies.name: Optical SETI
technologies.description: Laser pulse detection. Alternative to radio. +10% detection chance.

technologies.name: Kepler Exoplanet Database
technologies.description: Target selection from confirmed habitable zones. +10% system knowledge.

technologies.name: AI Pattern Recognition
technologies.description: Machine learning for signal analysis. +20 research points/turn.

technologies.name: Planetary Remediation
technologies.description: Geo-engineering and climate stabilization. Reduces Ecological Risk by 10% immediately and slows degradation.

technologies.name: Atmospheric Scrubbing
technologies.description: Industrial-scale carbon capture and scrubbing. Passive -0.001 Ecological Risk growth per turn.

technologies.name: Nano-Ecological Swarm
technologies.description: Self-replicating nanobots that repair ecosystems. Action: Purge Ecological Risk.

technologies.name: Square Kilometre Array (SKA)
technologies.description: World's largest radio telescope. Revolutionary sensitivity. +30% detection range.

technologies.name: Breakthrough Listen
technologies.description: $100M initiative (real, started 2015). Premium data & instruments. +25% detection.

technologies.name: Quantum Communication Detection
technologies.description: Detect quantum-encrypted signals. Access to post-digital civilizations.

technologies.name: Technosignature Cataloging
technologies.description: Detect industrial pollution, city lights, solar panels. Indirect detection. +15% knowledge.

technologies.name: AI Strategic Advisor
technologies.description: Advanced AI analyzes galactic patterns. Provides strategic recommendations.

technologies.name: Neutrino Telescope Networks
technologies.description: Detect neutrino bursts from advanced civilizations. Passive monitoring.

technologies.name: Gravitational Wave Communication
technologies.description: Detect ripples in spacetime. Kardashev Type II+ detection.

technologies.name: Dyson Sphere Detection Systems
technologies.description: Identify stellar engineering megastructures. Find Type II civilizations.

technologies.name: Orbital Defense Grid
technologies.description: Planetary defense platforms. Passive -40% attack damage.

technologies.name: Civilization Cloaking
technologies.description: Hide Earth's electromagnetic signature. Reduces passive detection by LA/LBA. -80% passive leakage.

technologies.name: Early Warning Network
technologies.description: Advanced sensor arrays. +2 generations warning time for attacks.

technologies.name: Relativistic Communication
technologies.description: Near-light-speed laser probes. Faster message delivery.

technologies.name: Distributed Backup Colonies
technologies.description: Mars, Europa, Titan settlements. Prevents total annihilation.

technologies.name: Stellar Engineering
technologies.description: Manipulate stars for signaling. Become visible to entire galaxy.

technologies.name: Post-Biological Transition
technologies.description: Digital consciousness. Contact post-biological civilizations.

technologies.name: Emergency Evacuation Infrastructure
technologies.description: Rapid population relocation systems. Ultimate survival guarantee.

technologies.name: Solar Sail Technology
technologies.description: Propellantless spacecraft using solar radiation pressure. Foundation for advanced propulsion.

technologies.name: Laser Sail Propulsion
technologies.description: Ground-based laser array propels gram-scale probes to 15-20% light speed (Breakthrough Starshot).

technologies.name: Von Neumann Probe Theory
technologies.description: Self-replicating exploration probes. Understand how to defend against or deploy them.

technologies.name: Fusion Propulsion
technologies.description: Deuterium/Helium-3 fusion rockets (Project Daedalus). Heavy payload interstellar capability.

technologies.name: Directional Transmission
technologies.description: Focused laser communications instead of omnidirectional broadcasts. -30% passive leakage.

technologies.name: Radio Silence Protocol
technologies.description: Minimize unintentional electromagnetic emissions. -50% passive leakage.

technologies.name: Dark Forest Protocol
technologies.description: Complete electromagnetic silence. Zero passive leakage but -50% public support permanently.

doctrine_choice.name: Accept Dark Forest Protocol
doctrine_choice.description: Achieve complete electromagnetic silence at the cost of permanent -50% public support

technologies.name: Bio-Engineering Foundation
technologies.description: Genetic modification and CRISPR techniques. Prerequisite for genetic integration technologies.

technologies.name: Genetic Pacification
technologies.description: Remove aggressive tribal instincts from human genome. +40-50% integration depending on approach.

doctrine_choice.name: Genetic Pacification Approach
doctrine_choice.description: How should we implement genetic modification to reduce aggression?

options.name: Voluntary Program
options.description: Offer genetic modification to willing participants. Less effective but maintains autonomy.

options.name: Mandatory Global Edit
options.description: Universal genetic modification for all humans. Maximum effectiveness but ethically controversial.

technologies.name: Neural Interface
technologies.description: Direct brain-computer connections. Merge biological cognition with digital processing. +40% integration.

technologies.name: Synthetic Biology
technologies.description: Engineer hybrid biological-technological organisms. Living machines and mechanical life. +30% integration.

technologies.name: Consciousness Upload
technologies.description: Transfer human consciousness to digital substrate. Digital immortality. +60% integration.

doctrine_choice.name: Upload Philosophy
doctrine_choice.description: What is the nature of uploaded consciousness?

options.name: Copy Theory
options.description: Upload creates a copy. Original biological consciousness remains. Both exist.

options.name: Continuity Theory
options.description: Upload is true transfer. Biological body becomes empty vessel. More controversial.

technologies.name: Hybrid Civilization
technologies.description: Complete biological-technological integration. Humanity transcends the Dual DNA crisis. Reduces self-destruct risk to 0.1%.
